tentacool-acid-armor.name: Acid Armor
tentacool-acid-armor.description: Bond skill: melts into a liquid body, becoming Fortified for 3 turns.

tentacool-sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
tentacool-sludge-wave.description: Bond skill: a wave of sludge hits every adjacent foe (Power 70) and Poisons them 2 turns.

tentacool-rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
tentacool-rapid-spin.description: Bond skill: spins, hitting every adjacent foe (Power 50, Attack), and slips free.

tentacool-clear-body.name: Clear Body
tentacool-clear-body.description: Cannot be Slowed or Exposed; takes 10% less damage.

tentacool-stinging-tentacles.name: Stinging Tentacles
tentacool-stinging-tentacles.description: Its hits on adjacent foes Poison them for 2 turns.

tentacool-screech.name: Screech
tentacool-screech.description: New skill: a piercing screech at a foe up to 2 hexes away leaves it Exposed for 2 turns.

tentacool-water-gun.name: Water Gun
tentacool-water-gun.description: New skill: squirts water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 40).

tentacool-rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
tentacool-rain-dish.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

tentacool-venomous-tendrils.name: Venomous Tendrils
tentacool-venomous-tendrils.description: Deals 25% more damage to Poisoned or Slowed foes.

tentacool-barrier.name: Barrier
tentacool-barrier.description: New skill: raises a barrier on itself or an ally up to 2 hexes away (Fortified for 2 turns).

tentacool-wring-out.name: Wring Out
tentacool-wring-out.description: New skill: squeezes a foe in its tentacles (Power 70).

tentacool-many-tentacles.name: Eighty Tentacles
tentacool-many-tentacles.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with its allies.

tentacool-drifting-body.name: Drifting Body
tentacool-drifting-body.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

tentacool-scald.name: Scald
tentacool-scald.description: New skill: boiling water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 65), Burning it for 2 turns.

tentacool-toxic.name: Toxic
tentacool-toxic.description: New skill: badly Poisons a foe up to 2 hexes away for 5 turns.

tentacool-lingering-venom.name: Lingering Venom
tentacool-lingering-venom.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 more turn.

tentacool-clinging-grip.name: Clinging Grip
tentacool-clinging-grip.description: Foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when stepping away.

tentacool-surf.name: Surf
tentacool-surf.description: New skill: a wave crashes down a 2-hex line (Power 65).

tentacool-whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
tentacool-whirlpool.description: New skill: traps a foe up to 2 hexes away in a vortex (Power 40), Slowing it for 2 turns.

tentacool-toxic-tide.name: Toxic Tide
tentacool-toxic-tide.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes with a status; cannot be Poisoned or Paralyzed.

tentacool-cleansing-tide.name: Cleansing Tide
tentacool-cleansing-tide.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

tentacool-tentacruels-reign.name: Reef Tyrant
tentacool-tentacruels-reign.description: Capstone. Its Poison moves deal 20% more; foes it afflicted spread it on fainting.

tentacool-ocean-hunter.name: Ocean Hunter
tentacool-ocean-hunter.description: Capstone. Its Water moves deal 20% more; heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.
